subject: Context & output-length breakout for pricing — prompt/completion mix and $/1M target
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@retailcloud.ai>, Sam Green <sam.green@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 17:20:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + ask: context length breakouts & cost targets

Hi Amelia / Sam —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through the recommendation engine and the product flows. I wanted to capture the key signals that matter for pricing so we can put together a short PoC proposal and a ballpark unit-econ. Please confirm anything I mis-specified below.

Summary of what I heard on the call:
- Monthly usage: ~6M inference calls (user-facing API calls) today, expected to grow to 8–12M in 6–9 months.
- Prompt / completion mix (rough avg): prompt tokens ~120 tokens, completion tokens ~420 tokens (weighted average across short/long flows).
- Context-length distribution (for context-aware retrieval + RAG): ~75% of calls fit within 8k context, ~20% need 32k, ~5% are long-form sessions that may require 128k (these are mostly batch analytics jobs).
- SLA: p95 latency target for interactive flows <= 400ms; bulk batch jobs can be slower.
- Compliance: SOC 2 in scope; plan to host in us-west for data residency.
- Target economics: you mentioned a target upper bound of roughly $2,500–3,500 per 1M tokens for commercial endpoints (this helps us size discounts/commits). Please confirm exact target.

What we need from you (next steps):
1) Confirm the distribution above or share a small sample export (CSV/JSONL) with per-call prompt & completion token counts so we can run a weighted cost model.
2) Confirm whether the 128k calls are real-time API calls or asynchronous batch jobs (this changes serving strategy).
3) Any preference for trial model type (smaller optimized quantized model vs higher-quality large model) — if unsure we can propose both and show the trade-offs.

I attached a simple template you can fill (retailcloud-usage-sample.jsonl) — if you can drop that in the Drive link I shared we’ll run a quick cost model and return an initial pricing scenario + PoC plan by EOW.

Thanks —
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0143

Attachments: retailcloud-usage-sample.jsonl (please upload), redwood-poc-template.csv (attached to drive)

From: Amelia Torres <amelia@retailcloud.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: context length breakouts & cost targets

Thanks Monica —

Couple of clarifications based on our analytics team:
- Monthly inference calls (current): 7.2M (consumer search + recommendations). Forecast 10–14M in 9 months with new retail partners.
- Token averages by flow (more granular):
  * Search autocomplete / suggestions (70% of calls): prompt 60 tokens / completion 80 tokens (short).
  * Personalized answer + reasoning (20%): prompt 300 tokens / completion 900 tokens.
  * Batch long-form analytics (10%): prompt avg 1,200 / completion 2,500 — these are mostly offline jobs but sometimes triggered ad-hoc.
- Context needs: 80% <= 8k, 15% ~32k, 5% ~128k (the 128k ones are typically the analytics/merchant reports).

We attached a 48-hour sample export (retailcloud-usage-sample.jsonl) to the Drive link you shared. The sample includes per-call token counts and a flag for "interactive" vs "batch".

Regarding economics: our procurement target is closer to $2,200 per 1M tokens (all-in, blended across prompt+completion), but we’re flexible if the architecture (e.g., heavy KV cache / batching / reserved capacity) materially reduces unit cost.

Happy to sync — can you share a back-of-envelope by Wed? We’re aiming to pick a vendor for a 6-week PoC by mid-December.

—Amelia
Head of Product | RetailCloud
amelia@retailcloud.ai

Attachments referenced: retailcloud-usage-sample.jsonl (uploaded to Drive)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@retailcloud.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quick recap + ask: context length breakouts & cost targets

Amelia — thanks for the sample and the follow-up detail. I put together a quick back-of-envelope based on the 48h sample and the distributions you called out. I’ll drop the full sheet to the Drive folder; attaching a short summary here.

Key assumptions (B-O-E):
- Use-case split: 70% short (avg 140 tokens total per call), 20% medium (1,200 tokens total), 10% long/batch (3,700 tokens total). Weighted average tokens per call: ~510.
- Monthly calls: conservatively 8M (mid-forecast). Total monthly tokens: ~4.08B tokens.

Model / deployment options (ballpark) — per 1M tokens (prompt+completion blended):
- Option A: optimized medium model (quantized, dense) — $1,900 / 1M tokens (good latency, lower quality on edge cases).
- Option B: high-quality large model (higher compute / memory) — $3,400 / 1M tokens (better long-form & safety).
- Option C: hybrid routing (short flows to smaller model, long/contextual flows to large) — blended $2,300 / 1M tokens (assumes smart routing + caching).

Applying blended to 4.08B tokens -> monthly cost estimates:
- Option A: ~$7,752
- Option B: ~$13,872
- Option C (recommended): ~$9,384

Notes and levers to reduce cost:
- Prefix/KV caching across sessions could cut completion compute by ~15–30% on your medium flows.
- Reserved / dedicated capacity commitment for peak pools reduces effective per-1M by ~20–30% depending on term.
- Offloading batch 128k jobs to an asynchronous lane reduces peak capacity needs (and cost) since you can use cheaper preemptible GPUs.

Next steps I propose:
1) We’ll upload the full prelim-econ-estimate.xlsx to the Drive (contains per-flow costing and sensitivity to context length).
2) If you’re interested in PoC, we can spin a 6-week trial with usage caps and a small commit (e.g., $20k) — we’ll instrument cost dashboards and token-level breakdowns.
3) Marcus (cc) will scope the infra plan (region, VPC options) and alignment on SOC2 evidence.

If Amelia is comfortable with the hybrid blended target (~$2.3k / 1M tokens), we’ll draft a short commercial that includes a trial & 3-month reserved discount.

– Karthik
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: prelim-econ-estimate.xlsx, redwood-pricing-proposal-v1.pdf

From: Sam Green <sam.green@novacorp.com>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: context length breakouts & cost targets

Thanks all —

This looks reasonable and aligned with our procurement guardrails. We’re happy to proceed with the hybrid routing proposal and the PoC cadence Karthik suggested. Proposed next steps:
- Kickoff: Mon, 29 Nov — 30–45 min technical kickoff with RetailCloud eng + Redwood infra + solutions.
- Trial commitment: $25k initial commit for usage caps and support credits.
- Deliverables: cost dashboard, per-token breakdown, 2 sample production endpoints (8k and 32k contexts).

Amelia — can you confirm the kickoff attendee list? I’ll get legal to prepare a short SOW / MSA addendum for the trial.

Best,
Sam
